updateMask.description:
Fields of rate_limit to update, among name, description, expr,
status, priority, action, time_window, max_requests and timeout ("*"
for all of them); without one, those set in rate_limit. A named field
unset in rate_limit is cleared.

Fields of secrule to update, among name, description, expr, status,
priority and action ("*" for all of them); without one, those set in
secrule. A named field unset in secrule is cleared.

Fields of ruleset to update, among name, description and
ruleset ("*" for all of them); without one, those set in ruleset.
A named field unset in ruleset is cleared.

expr.description:
Applies only to the requests matching the expression, empty = every
request (global). It is translated to SecLang rules: the body, JA4
and TLS sources are not supported.

@gotags: yaml:"expr"

v1Exclusion.description: Exclusion false-positive tuning by tag or rule target.

v1ExclusionTarget.description: ExclusionTarget removes a variable from a rule, ex: 942100 ARGS:password.

v1FieldSource.title: The possible sources from which a field can be extracted in a request

v1KeyMode.description:
How a variant of a source uses the key of the condition.

 - KEY_MODE_NONE: The key must be empty: the source has a single value (path, IP...).
 - KEY_MODE_REQUIRED: The key names the field to read, e.g. the header "User-Agent".

total.description: Number of rules matching the filters, whatever the page.
Number of tags matching the filters, whatever the page.

v1Managed.description: Managed a ruleset maintained by a provider other than OWASP.

list.description: The value is a non-empty list of value_kind items.

enumValues.description: The allowed values of VALUE_KIND_ENUM, compared case-sensitively.

v1OperatorSpec.description: An operator a variant accepts, with the value it compares to.

v1RequestPolicy.description: RequestPolicy request handling directives and CRS setup variables.

system.description:
System rules (init, evaluation, skip markers) cannot be overridden.

@gotags: yaml:"system"

v1RuleInfo.description: RuleInfo catalog entry of a CRS rule, used by the console.

expr.description:
Applies only to the requests matching the expression, empty = every
request (global). Only RULE_STATE_DISABLED can be scoped. Same
translation and limits as Exclusion.expr.

@gotags: yaml:"expr"

v1RuleOverride.description: RuleOverride changes the state of a single CRS rule.

v1RuleState.title:
- RULE_STATE_DISABLED: removed (ctl:ruleRemoveById)
 - RULE_STATE_DETECTION_ONLY: logged, not counted toward blocking
 - RULE_STATE_ENABLED: forced on above paranoia_level

ruleCount.description: Number of rules carrying the tag, among the ones the request covers.

v1RuleTag.description: RuleTag tag of the OWASP CRS catalog, ex: "attack-sqli".

timeWindow.description: Counting window, as a Go duration string (e.g. "10s", "1m").

maxRequests.description: Maximum number of requests allowed within time_window.

timeout.description: Block duration once the limit is exceeded, as a Go duration string.

v1Setting.description:
Setting the rulesets of a server (namespace): OWASP CRS and the managed
rulesets of other providers.

v1SourceSpec.description:
The variants of a source, picked by the key: a source has at most one
variant per KeyMode.

name.description: Stable name of the variant, e.g. "value" or "presence".

v1SourceVariant.description: A way to read a source: the key it takes and the operators it accepts.

v1ValueKind.description:
The kind of the value of a condition. The value is always a string, or a
list of strings when the operator spec is a list: the edge reads it as
such, a JSON number or bool would never match.

 - VALUE_KIND_STRING: Any non-empty text.
 - VALUE_KIND_NUMBER: A decimal number, e.g. "1024" or "0.5".
 - VALUE_KIND_REGEX: A regular expression in the RE2 syntax.
 - VALUE_KIND_IP: An IP address or a CIDR prefix, e.g. "10.0.0.1" or "10.0.0.0/8".
 - VALUE_KIND_ENUM: One of the enum_values of the operator spec.
 - VALUE_KIND_NAME: The name of a header or a query parameter.
